title: A w:tblpXSpec keyword places a floating table against its horzAnchor band (margin box, paper, text column), never at a default X
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf gridline x and text bboxes; Letter, left margin 72 pt, right margin 36 pt (column 72-576), Calibri 11, 150 pt fixed one-cell tables; right keyword on the margin band draws 425.5-575.5, on the page band 461.5-611.5; center on the margin band 248.6-398.6, on the page band 230.6-380.6; left on the page band 0-150 (the anchor paragraph's first lines start at 151); a numeric tblpX 7000 on the text band draws at 422 = 72 + 350; the same keyword in an indented anchor paragraph (ind left 720) still ends at 576; inside on an even page and outside on an odd page both draw 425.5-575.5 (the keyword follows page parity)

cases.note: A1 margin right: the box ends at the right margin (576), not at tblInd + 9360 twips
A2 page right: the box ends at the paper edge
A3 margin center: centred on the 72-576 margin box
A4 page center: centred on the paper
A5 margin inside on an EVEN page = the right (binding) side; gen resolves inside as left on every page (page parity not modelled)
A6 margin outside on an odd page = the right side
A8 page left: flush with the paper edge, overhanging the left margin
A10 numeric tblpX 7000 on the text band: 72 + 350
A7 text-band right keyword in an indented anchor paragraph: the column edge, the indent is ignored
A9 right keyword, 550 pt table on a 504 pt column: the right edge stays pinned, the box overhangs the left margin (Word 25.4-575.5)
A1 editor: the right float keeps the stylesheet's zero right margin, no column - 624px - width expression
A2 editor: the page band overhangs the right margin
A8 editor: the page band's left keyword starts at the paper edge
A9 editor: the over-wide right float stays floated on the right band (CSS places an over-wide right float flush right, overhanging left)
D1 nested margin right: flush with the cell's right edge (Word 425.3-575.3)
D2 nested margin center: centred in the cell (Word 249.1-399.1)
D3 nested page right: the page band is the cell too (Word 425.5-575.5, not the paper edge 612)
H1 header margin right keyword: 425.5 - 72 from the strip's left edge
H2 header page center keyword: 230.6 - 72
H3 header vertAnchor=margin tblpY=0: the table top at the body margin (72), 36 pt below the strip top
A4 editor: the page band centres on the paper, not the content box (231 vs 249 with 72 / 36 pt margins)
